protocol.primary_subset: 32 core_corner cells only; matched and posthoc probes excluded
protocol.primary_rule: for every axis pooled normal below zero and >=70% case wins; combined normal below zero and shuffled/static/closed; >=24/32 core cells pass six-axis pooled-by-motion rule

limitations: Frozen stress map; no retraining or model selection.
Posthoc probes repeat series-78 failure-inspired views and are excluded from primary.
Grid maps only a synthetic parameter family, not arbitrary natural vision.
Replay reconstructs observed action; contacts and actuator dynamics are not evaluated.
